title: Combat decision dialogs
description: The real web UI for Assault Cannon, anti-fighter barrage, Courageous to the End, the bombardment target, Vortex and the Cabal agent capture, taken from real engine games at desktop and phone size, before and right after answering.

shots.heading: Assault Cannon: before answering, desktop
shots.caption: [assault_cannon_destroy, seat 2, 1440x900] Seat 2 (Hacan, attacker) is asked which ship the Assault Cannon destroys: the fleet rows show "Click to assign" on the legal targets (Carrier and Dreadnought).

shots.heading: Assault Cannon: before answering, phone
shots.caption: [assault_cannon_destroy, seat 2, 390x844] Seat 2 (Hacan, attacker) is asked which ship the Assault Cannon destroys: the fleet rows show "Click to assign" on the legal targets (Carrier and Dreadnought).

shots.heading: Assault Cannon: after answering, desktop
shots.caption: [assault_cannon_destroy, seat 2, 1440x900] The result: the Dreadnought is gone (x0, -1) and the next question, the anti-fighter barrage window, is on screen.

shots.heading: Assault Cannon: after answering, phone
shots.caption: [assault_cannon_destroy, seat 2, 390x844] The result: the Dreadnought is gone (x0, -1) and the next question, the anti-fighter barrage window, is on screen.

shots.heading: Anti-fighter barrage window: before answering, desktop
shots.caption: [reaction_when_ANTI_FIGHTER_BARRAGE_STARTED, seat 2, 1440x900] Seat 2 (Hacan) holds a reaction window "when anti-fighter barrage started" before the rolls: play Waylay (barrage hits count against all ships) or Pass.

shots.heading: Anti-fighter barrage window: before answering, phone
shots.caption: [reaction_when_ANTI_FIGHTER_BARRAGE_STARTED, seat 2, 390x844] Seat 2 (Hacan) holds a reaction window "when anti-fighter barrage started" before the rolls: play Waylay (barrage hits count against all ships) or Pass.

shots.heading: Anti-fighter barrage window: after answering, desktop
shots.caption: [reaction_when_ANTI_FIGHTER_BARRAGE_STARTED, seat 2, 1440x900] After the answer (Pass): the next reaction window, "after unit ability rolled" (Scramble Frequency), is shown.

shots.heading: Anti-fighter barrage window: after answering, phone
shots.caption: [reaction_when_ANTI_FIGHTER_BARRAGE_STARTED, seat 2, 390x844] After the answer (Pass): the next reaction window, "after unit ability rolled" (Scramble Frequency), is shown.

shots.heading: Courageous to the End: before answering, desktop
shots.caption: [courageous_to_the_end_assign_casualty, seat 2, 1440x900] Seat 2 (Hacan) assigns the Courageous to the End hit: Carrier or Fighters can be clicked.

shots.heading: Courageous to the End: before answering, phone
shots.caption: [courageous_to_the_end_assign_casualty, seat 2, 390x844] Seat 2 (Hacan) assigns the Courageous to the End hit: Carrier or Fighters can be clicked.

shots.heading: Courageous to the End: after answering, desktop
shots.caption: [courageous_to_the_end_assign_casualty, seat 2, 1440x900] After the answer: combat has moved on to round 2 and seat 3 is the one being asked.

shots.heading: Courageous to the End: after answering, phone
shots.caption: [courageous_to_the_end_assign_casualty, seat 2, 390x844] After the answer: combat has moved on to round 2 and seat 3 is the one being asked.

shots.heading: Bombardment target choice: before answering, desktop
shots.caption: [bombardment_target, seat 3, 1440x900] Invasion of system 32: the bombarding player is asked whose units on the planet take the next hits. The two options read as raw player ids.

shots.heading: Bombardment target choice: before answering, phone
shots.caption: [bombardment_target, seat 3, 390x844] Invasion of system 32: the bombarding player is asked whose units on the planet take the next hits. The two options read as raw player ids.

shots.heading: Bombardment target choice: after answering, desktop
shots.caption: [bombardment_target, seat 3, 1440x900] After the answer: the invasion continues.

shots.heading: Bombardment target choice: after answering, phone
shots.caption: [bombardment_target, seat 3, 390x844] After the answer: the invasion continues.

shots.heading: Vortex: before answering, desktop
shots.caption: [vortex_target, seat 3, 1440x900] Seat 3 (Cabal) picks the unit type Vortex captures from a player's reinforcements. The dialog title and source read as raw ids (VTX).

shots.heading: Vortex: before answering, phone

notes.title: Source
notes.text: Real engine games driven by the Playwright smoke run (presets siege, bombard, capture; game seeds 11, 21, 32; click seeds 4, 4, 6 and 4 for the second Cabal capture). Nothing is mocked or edited. Reproduce with web/e2e/screenshots/BJ-combat-decisions/capture-real.sh.

notes.title: What after means
notes.text: The after shot is the same seat's page right after its answer landed, so it shows the next state or question (the result), not the old dialog.

notes.title: Rough edges visible in these shots
notes.text: Raw ids show in the bombardment options (player_...), the reaction titles (when ANTI FIGHTER BARRAGE STARTED), Vortex (VTX) and the Cabal agent (CABALAGENT, sol_infantry, hacan_mech). The Courageous to the End and Assault Cannon dialogs are the generic combat view with no card name.
